# Skills

AI agent skills repository powered by [txtskills](https://github.com/hk-vk/txtskills).

Generate and install skills from llms.txt documentation files.

## Usage

Install a skill:
```bash
npx skills add hk-vk/skills --skill <skill-name>
```

## About

This repository stores AI agent skills generated from llms.txt documentation files.
Skills are auto-generated and can be installed directly into your AI coding agents.
